The '''MA-9 Frontline Droid''' was a model of bipedal [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] available during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The MA-9 was marketed as being obedient, adaptive, and deadly, and was equipped with a jet charge and a blade built into its bracer, as well as an optional carbonizing spray. The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] arms dealer [[Olok]] the Shadow sold MA-9 Frontline Droids in his auction on [[Darvannis]].

==Behind the scenes==
MA-9 Frontline Droids appear as one of the four types of droid enemies in the Olok the Shadow boss encounter in the Operation "Scum and Villainy," which was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the Digital Expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']].<ref name="TOR" />
